verdict.rationale: Aider is a terminal-based coding agent. It installs locally via pip or a curl script, runs from the command line with files named as arguments, and edits and commits code in your local git repo. It can also use local models via Ollama. Community users confirm hands-on use as a coding agent. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the install/local-run experience specifically (e.g., platform coverage, setup friction).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Do this by naming them on the aider command line.
Whenever aider edits a file, it commits those changes with a descriptive commit message.
Aider can work also with local models, for example using Ollama.
Aider is one of my favorite AI agents, especially because it can work with existing codebases.
